info.summary: Your personal assistant: today, calendar, trips and reminders
Je persoonlijke assistent: vandaag, agenda, reizen en herinneringen
info.description:
**AskAnina: your personal assistant, right inside Nextcloud.**
AskAnina keeps your day in order and thinks ahead for you. Open it from Nextcloud's menu, or add the **AskAnina Today** widget to your Dashboard.
▶ **[Watch AskAnina in Nextcloud in 1 minute](https://askanina.com/videos/en/askanina-nextcloud-1-minute.mp4)**
- **Today at a glance:** appointments, reminders, tasks, weather warnings and what's coming up, in one calm overview. - **Everything connected:** AskAnina links your people, appointments, places, trips, documents and notes, so one tap shows everything that belongs together, and its history. - **Your Nextcloud calendars, contacts and Deck:** AskAnina works with what you already have. - **On time, everywhere:** travel times to every appointment, when to leave, traffic, parking, flights and fuel prices along the way. - **Trips:** plan whole journeys, share them with the people travelling with you. - **Deliveries, documents and expiry dates:** know what's arriving and what's about to expire. - **Health, podcasts, news, TV and more:** everything in one place, on your phone and in Nextcloud.
Sign in with your AskAnina account. New accounts get **14 days of everything, free**. Using AskAnina in Nextcloud is part of the Plus and Complete plans.
Your data stays yours: how AskAnina handles it is at https://askanina.com.
_This Nextcloud app is open source (Apache-2.0). The AskAnina service it opens is © Ramin Berwers, all rights reserved._
